scope: All11 tracked blobs read including implementation, license, README, setup/build and configuration.

findings.finding: Hash->single filename map overwrites prior same-hash filename, while BKTree inserts another same-value node. Search can repeat latest filename and lose earlier files; clearTreeCache rebuild collapses duplicate hash nodes, changing result multiplicity.
Only basename stored, losing directory identity. No source snapshot/freshness validation, byte/pixel confirmation or low-information gate.
Duplicate hash insertion follows distance0 child chain. Repeated identical hashes cost quadratic insertion and linear-depth node storage; README unconditional O(log n)/million-scale claim unproven.
BKTree search uses int hi=distance+maxDistance without validation; maxDistance=Integer.MAX_VALUE may overflow and prune matches. Negative radius accepted without explicit policy error.

pHash comment says exclude DC but code includes dct[0][0]. applyDCT calculates all1024 coefficients with nested32x32 sums and repeated cos evaluations although only64 coefficients are used. Candidate lesson: bounded precomputation/selected coefficients needs bitwise+paired performance qualification before adoption.

ImageIO.read may return null for unsupported bytes; immediately dereferenced. No image-dimension/decode budget, frame/EXIF policy or cancellation; graphics allocations and maps unbounded by explicit resource policy.
Mutable service maps/tree are not synchronized; no concurrent ownership contract. Query-file comment claims self exclusion but no exclusion implemented.
Only Java standard library production sources; no upstream test files, tracked media or CI in commit. Maven publish/sign plugins read but not executed.

limits: Full tracked source/license/configuration read, all Git blobs and canonical tree objects verified; no tracked images/GIF/video.
Reference concepts only; no foreign production code adopted.
Static review is not complete runtime, cross-platform, image-quality or scale qualification.
